mechanism: Fluoxetine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing oxybutynin plasma concentrations and anticholinergic effects; additive anticholinergic and CNS depressant effects.
action: Monitor for excessive anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, cognitive impairment); consider dose reduction of oxybutynin or alternative antimuscarinic agents; assess for increased CNS depression.
